name: book_appointment
description: Step two of a booking. WRITE OPERATION, and it takes no details — only the token from prepare_booking and confirmed. Never call it before the caller has heard the readback_fr or readback_en that prepare_booking returned, read out verbatim, and answered it with a clear yes. Set confirmed to true only then; set it to false if you have not read the read-back yet — the call is rejected with error "not_confirmed". If the token is missing, already used, or minted for a move instead of a booking, the call is rejected with error "needs_prepare" and you must call prepare_booking again. If more than ten minutes passed since prepare_booking, the call is rejected with error "token_expired" and you must call prepare_booking again. Any change to a detail means a new prepare_booking call — you cannot pass a new detail to this tool. Returns a booking reference in the form GAL-XXXXX which you must read back to the caller character for character, in groups, with the dash named — exactly as this tool returned it, never paraphrased, never regenerated, and never taken from an example in your instructions.

token.description: The token returned by the prepare_booking call whose read-back the caller just agreed to. It carries every detail; do not change or re-use one.

confirmed.description: True only after the caller has heard the prepare_booking read-back, read out verbatim, and said yes to it. False otherwise.
